# Workflows that declare workflow_dispatch but are not yet on the
# default branch (#644), enforced by scripts/check-dispatch-reachable.sh.
#
# GitHub only exposes a dispatchable workflow from the DEFAULT branch.
# This project develops on `dev` and releases to `main`, and `main` is
# the default, so a new dispatch-only workflow is undispatchable for one
# release cycle after it merges. That is normal; being undispatchable
# and DOCUMENTED AS A ROUTE is not.
#
# Rules:
#   - An entry requires a reason and what clears it. No bare paths.
#   - The documentation for the workflow must say it is not available
#     yet, for as long as the entry is here.
#   - The gate fails when an entry stops being needed — the workflow
#     reached the default branch, so remove the entry. An allowlist
#     nobody prunes is how a temporary exception becomes permanent.
#
# .github/workflows/capture-fixtures.yml: re-records the request fixtures
#   on the integration lane (#665). Merged to `dev` on 2026-08-20; the
#   first dispatch answered 404, which is what this gate now exists to
#   catch. Cleared by the v1.8.0 release, when `dev` reaches `main` —
#   at which point it should be dispatched once to verify it end to end
#   (docs/release-runbook.md, "Verifying"), and this entry removed.
.github/workflows/capture-fixtures.yml

# .github/workflows/netboot-image.yml: builds the arm64 lane's boot server
#   image and checks what it installs into the Pi's root filesystem.
#   Merged to `dev` after v1.8.0's release branch was cut, so it is
#   undispatchable until the next release carries it to `main`. It needs
#   no dispatch to do its job — it fires on pull requests and pushes that
#   touch test/arm64-netboot/ — so nothing is blocked meanwhile. Cleared
#   by the next release, when `dev` reaches `main`; remove this entry
#   then.
.github/workflows/netboot-image.yml

# .github/workflows/label-taxonomy.yml: the live half of the label-taxonomy
#   gate (#715). Declares both `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch`, and
#   NEITHER fires off the default branch — so between merging to `dev` and
#   the next release this workflow does not run at all. Nothing is blocked
#   meanwhile: the half that gates pull requests is
#   `check-label-taxonomy.sh --static` in test.yaml, and the live half can
#   be run by hand with `bash scripts/check-label-taxonomy.sh --live`.
#   Cleared by the next release, when `dev` reaches `main`; dispatch it once
#   to verify it end to end, then remove this entry.
.github/workflows/label-taxonomy.yml
